comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Mangle (6-knob). Feedback delay with three blendable mangle characters: Crush (degradation) + Tremolo (amplitude wobble) both in the feedback so they compound; Pitch (octave-down grain shimmer) feed-forward on the output. All at 0 = clean delay. No switch anywhere (jump table = freeze).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 0x01D6. Reverted from 483 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 483 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Crush
params.comment: params[7]. Degradation depth (sample-rate reduce + bitcrush + darken), in the feedback so it compounds. 0 = off.

params.name: Tremolo
params.comment: params[8]. Amplitude-wobble depth (~4.5 Hz), in the feedback so repeats pulse harder each pass. 0 = off.

params.name: Pitch
params.comment: params[9]. Octave-down grain shimmer on the wet output (feed-forward). 0 = off.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
